text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ("Food"—the true source of power for those who run.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally! Even here at Tracen Academy,
we exercise the utmost care and consideration
regarding everything our students consume――)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman, good work on the online meeting.
...Oh? Are you heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! There's about an hour before our next engagement!
I shall go check on the fields for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Is this about the selective breeding?
Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. A sugar content of 9.5, is it?
Quite impressive, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the vitamin content increased from last time. Maybe I'll take it back and analyze it...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(The ideal diet for the students.
To that end, between my duties,
I have made every effort humanly possible.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(Daily care, soil prep, pest and animal control.
There are countless steps to take for selective breeding!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(I have kept at this for quite some time—yet,
reaching the ideal remains frustratingly elusive—)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Hrmm. Beta-carotene, vitamin C, iron, calcium... The results of the selective breeding are evident in the data, but...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What we need a bit more of is sweetness!
The students love sweets!
After all, food is vital for satisfying the soul as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"……There is still room for improvement!
Shall I reconsider the soil preparation as well? Hmmm……"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it is truly clear! Warm!
A wonderfully pleasant spring day!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, no way, no way!
I can't let sleepiness beat me!
Sure, I've been busy lately, but..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...? Wh-What is this sight...?
Where on earth are we...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!?
T-The... Three Goddesses...!?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: —To you, who cares deeply for every student at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
To you, who wishes for every student
to pursue their dreams and keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To you, who prays that every student
continues to grow up healthy and strong.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
How you put it to use is up to you and everyone at the academy.
Even so—please, accept it.

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text: Our modest blessing—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Huh!? A... A dream!?
...B-But if so... then why...!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh?! W-What was that?
Did the field just glow for a second...?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...What is this?
The vegetables and the soil look even more radiant than they did moments ago...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Am I... still dreaming,
I wonder...?
......"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Agh! Is it a dream or reality?!
There's only one way to find out: by eating it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!?
Th-This taste...!? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Sooooo sweeeet!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is... over 12 degrees on the Brix scale!
Such sweetness and flavor...!
And vitality is coursing through my whole body...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Has it finally... finally
been completed...?”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"The vegetables I sought!
The ideal meal for the students!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot simply stand by!
As chairwoman, there is only one thing I must do!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Students and Trainers!
Thank you for gathering on such short notice!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Alright! First things first! To start off...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Bon appétit!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this carrot?! It's crazy delicious~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Both the potatoes and the strawberries...!
Rice has never tasted vegetables this delicious before...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not just delicious...!
With every single bite, it feels like
energy is welling up inside me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My Buono Power is charging up~!
Dosukoi, dosukko~i!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Believe it or not, these were all grown right in the academy's fields!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? You were good before, but didn't
you suddenly jump up a whole 'nother level!?
How on earth did you...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now then! This is where the real business begins!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, everyone!
What does food truly mean to athletes like yourselves?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Food is the source that builds the body! The vitality for running!
The joy of daily life! It is, quite literally, your very lives!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as the Academy Chairwoman, I have engaged in
continuous trial and error to produce superior vegetables—the ideal nutritional diet!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The fruits of our labor are the very vegetables you just ate!
And the soil that nurtured them!
The academy's fields are in an absolute state of perfection!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"—Fellow students and Trainers!
Please lend us your strength to seize this golden opportunity!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Further development and growth of our field!
Cultivating and harvesting all-new vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, developing new recipes!
The supreme athletic diet, packed with the
nutrition worthy of those who run!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To turn this academy into a gastronomic utopia!
Everyone, please lend me your strength!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Today—at this very moment!
All the fields are hereby opened to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... I can grow as many
of those delicious veggies as I want?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...M-Maybe I should give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sooo many buono vegetables...!
That's super bono-buono, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I put my heart into it, I'm sure they'll grow up
delicious... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Allow me to share my dream with you all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I can see it.
The ideal nourishment overflowing throughout the academy—
and all of you brimming with joy and vitality.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Growing up healthy, free of injury and illness—
she keeps running, as far as her legs desire.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To seize my very own dream—
no matter how far... no matter how far!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Let us seize such a future... together!
